description: Verify that Notification UDP src_port matches OfferService Endpoint Option port (TR_SOMEIP_00360 / 00361)
approach:
[Objective]
Notification UDP src_port matches OfferService Endpoint Option port (TR_SOMEIP_00360 / 00361).

[Scenario — chronological]
DUT emits a qualifying SD message (OfferService / Subscribe Ack / Nack). The harness captures it and validates the asserted property byte-precisely.

[Pass condition]
The asserted property holds on the wire.

[Fail condition]
Fail_<state> per the listed verdicts; Fail_timeout if no qualifying SD message arrived.

verdicts.Pass: Notification src_port matches Offer endpoint port — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase1_no_offer_with_endpoint: No OfferService with IPv4 endpoint within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase3_src_port_mismatch: Notification src_port does not match Offer endpoint port
